senses.gloss: f. (pronunc. and meaning doubtful) Illitha, something supposed to render fire-proof or extinguish the fire.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 108b:2">Snh. 108ᵇ</cite> <he>יש לנו דבר אחד וא׳ שמה</he> Ar. (ed. <he>וע׳</he>) we have something, its name is Ill. [perhaps to be read <he>דבר אחר</he> a (female) idol]; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 906">Yalk. Job 906</cite> <cite ref="P00835"><he>עיל׳</he></cite>, Ms. <he>עליונה</he>]. [<cite ref="Bava Batra 73a:8">B. Bath. 73ᵃ</cite> <he>ומחינן ליה באלי׳</he> Ar. Var. s. v. <cite ref="A01956"><he>אלתא</he></cite>, ed. <cite ref="A01829"><he>אַלּוּתָא</he></cite>, Rashi <cite ref="A01808"><he>אַלְוָותָא</he></cite>, Ms. Oxf. <he>ואית לן</he>, <cite ref="A01808"><he>אלוותא</he></cite> pl. of <cite ref="A01956"><he>אַלָּתָא</he></cite>. The use of the masc. gend. in connection with the word, makes the passage appear spurious.]
